name: Improvement strategy (credible plan with timeline)

regulatory_anchors.regulation: FCA Policy Statement PS23/16: Sustainability Disclosure Requirements (SDR) and investment labels
regulatory_anchors.article: Chapter 4: Sustainability labels (paragraphs 4.28-4.31 — Sustainability Improvers requires credible plan with reasonable timeframe)

summary: Tests whether the developer has a credible improvement plan with a defined timeline and specific actions. PS23/16 ¶4.29 requires a 'robust evidence-based plan' but does not quantify the timeline; PB methodology v3.5 calibrates the aligned band at ≤3 years with ≥3 specific actions (consistent with industry-standard expectations for material sustainability improvement at data centres), partially_aligned at ≤5 years, and not_aligned beyond that. Reading the strategy in conjunction with the baseline (c5) establishes whether the trajectory is internally consistent.
